notes.title: Living in a Brothel v0.4.1 released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/654e6bb360cb05175013025f3813304bf7e9a283.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/d72d8b30a7cb57626365d32f4d77a1b4510f21a0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9be3b472106b538f8a3907b156f2235510a2384e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/326e736d6c38d10ce550984de95e62f047fe18f3.png
What's up, guys!
We’re thrilled to announce that Living in a Brothel version 0.4.1 is officially here!
This update brings a mix of fresh content, polish, and that special flair you’ve come to love.

You may find it weird that the title says v0.4.1 and not v0.4.0, but that's exactly what it is.
During the testing phase, we discovered some bugs and took the opportunity to fix them before launching on Steam.
This version, with the bugs fixed, was called v0.4.1.

Without further ado, here’s what’s new:
============//============
Version 0.4.1:
Fucking Your Customer Scene Remake:

Fixed an issue where the main character had female nails in some parts of this scene.
To do this, we needed to redo several renders and animations:

 19 Renders Remade
 7 Animations Remade

Improvements:

Gamepad A Button Update: The gamepad A button now functions similarly to the left mouse button instead of the Enter button as it did previously.
This allows you to drag and collect Secret Cards from posters. (Steam Version Only)

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where clicking on some Gallery Image thumbnails in the menu would incorrectly display a different Gallery Image than the one selected.
============//============
Version 0.4.0:
New Content:

 283 New Renders
 61 New Animations
 7 New Gallery Images
 7 New Scenes
 5 New Songs
 2 New Achievements
 2 Gallery Images were turned into animations

New Features:

Exploring the City: Now the player will be able to access other parts of the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door.
For now, the only accessible location is the gym, but in the future, more locations in the city will be accessible as the story progresses.

Steam Cloud Support: Added support for the Steam Cloud feature.
You can now share your save between different devices when playing the Steam version, as well as keep a backup of your save in the cloud.

Improvements:

Monochromatic Effect: The code related to the monochromatic effect, which is used in character memories, has been optimized.
It's now possible to use this effect in animations.

Updated Achievements Requirements: The requirements for unlock the achievements listed in the Achievement Menu have been updated to include the new content in this version.
Players will need to complete the requirements related to the new content in order to unlock achievements that were previously present in the game.

Automatic New Clothes: The code related to the implementation of renders that change the character's outfit depending on the day the game is in has been optimized.
Now, new outfits that appears in future updates will be included automatically, without the need for changes to the code.

Way to unlock Gallery Images updated: 13 Gallery Images that were previously automatically unlocked in bulk are now unlocked via Secret Cards or through the main storyline, one by one.

Jackpot Animation: When you hit a Jackpot in the Slot Machine Minigame, an animation is played along with the previously existing sound effect from now on.

Performance Boost: We have optimized the use of cache memory and RAM, ensuring a significant performance gain. On the other hand, the game's RAM usage has increased and, consequently, the required specifications.
This has resulted in faster loading of game files, which can be especially noticeable in animations, which now run smoothly. You'll also notice that the game will respond more quickly to your inputs from now on.

Adjustments:

Committed Reader Achievement: We've reduced the percentage of script that must be read to unlock this achievement from 95% to 90%.
This achievement was harder to unlock than we planned, so we've adjusted the requirements to make it easier for players to reach.

Diagonal Jackpots: From now on, when you manage to line up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" diagonally in the Slot Machine Minigame, it'll count as a Jackpot.
We initially decided to only count a Jackpot when you lined up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" in the center, as we wanted this to be a hard achievement to unlock, but we felt that the difficulty was higher than we had planned.
This change should make it easier to unlock the Jackpot achievement, while still keeping it sufficiently challenging.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where "The Curious Girl" scene was unlocked in the Replay section before being completed during gameplay.

Fixed a bug where, in specific situations, character icons would not load during mobile conversations, messing up the layout, and consequently, it was not possible to read them properly.
============//============
A huge thank you to our amazing community for your support so far – you’re the reason we keep pushing Living in a Brothel forward. If you haven’t already, hop into our Discord server to share your thoughts, report bugs, or just chat.
Time to head back to the brothel and see what version 0.4.1 has in store for you.
Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: Living in a Brothel v0.4.0 is completed
notes.content:
What's up, guys!
Let's start this post with the news everyone wanted to hear:
The version 0.4.0 is complete and is currently in testing phase.

From time to time, we usually post news about the game's development here on Steam, but if you want to stay as up to date as possible, we recommend that you access our Discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/9wnXg9vqA4


That said, there has been some progress in development since our last post.
This post is to share with you the news that has occurred since then.
Let's talk in detail by topic:

Julia Sex Scene - First Part
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/d08da3719bbc1f36620a8b6d02d36f66ef6aa90c.png
The highlight of this update is the wide variety of preview images attached to this topic.
In them you can see several new details, such as Julia's room, which is a new room that will be accessible from v0.5, and will also be where the Julia Sex Scene will take place.
It's also possible to finally see Julia completely nude. (Images 1 & 2)
You can also see the Main Character right after he enters the room still dressed in his bartender outfit. (Images 3 & 4)
And you can also see the characters getting ready to go into action. (Images 5, 6 & 7)
We also included some facial expressions of the characters during the dialogues. (Images 2, 4, 6 & 7)

Telling you a little more about our progress, we've already finished working on all the animations that will make up the Julia Sex Scene.
We've also created some variations using the same images, as we have done throughout the development period so far. These variations will be available to you in the next update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/6c79fec81f8846501aa25b92cf727ffdc4e2abf6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/0b33f5f92b7c1e24b527c88165e523a7597eb53f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3971eb6f6092c3b94261a4d0d59185f6754bf71e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8f453d05eb5ee4fd3d7bd23afbfaca508044ac55.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4e2a7c6f6861bde7c3fdc239cf00605267629967.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/bc7cddba03634eae4cb2aa41b229e3c414069994.png

Julia Sex Scene - Second Part

This is the last batch of preview images before the conclusion of Episode 4, or version 0.4, as you prefer.

To celebrate the upcoming release, we're taking advantage of the fact that this is the last set of preview

What's new in version 0.4.0?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e6b70ff6c30630b14c3a8d0d26f75a09d0865a30.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a64bb95dc81cc49683414b1c56e592639a6d3dc6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/25bf5b567636ea8de4727e014f52dcca17a21710.png
In the testing phase, we take the opportunity to fix bugs we found and implement some changes that we didn't have the opportunity to implement previously, but that would have been welcome.

In short, we took the opportunity to optimize the experience as much as possible before making the new update available to the public, as we want our players' experience to be the best possible.

Let's briefly talk about everything that has been implemented so far:

Exploring the City: From this version onwards, the player will be able to explore new locations in the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door.
At first, we only have the gym available, but in the future more locations will be accessible.

Steam Cloud Support: We have a new feature exclusive to the Steam version, Steam Cloud support.
You can now share your save between different devices using Steam's cloud service, and you can also keep a backup of your save.

This is a feature requested by some players that, for technical reasons, had not been implemented until now, but we have overcome this limitation and made this feature available to players starting with this update.

Monochromatic Effect: The code related to the monochromatic effect, which is used in character memories, has been optimized.
It's now possible to use this effect in animations.

Updated Achievements Requirements: The requirements needed to earn achievements that already existed in the game have been updated to accommodate the new content available in this update.

This means that, for example, to unlock the "Detective" achievement, which consists of unlocking all Gallery Images, the player will also have to unlock the new Gallery Images that were added in this version.

Automatic New Clothes: The code related to the implementation of renders that change the character's outfit depending on the day the game is in has been optimized.
Now, new outfits that appears in future updates will be included automatically, without the need for changes to the code.
This is a "back end" update and will not be noticed by the player during gameplay, but it'll help in the development of future versions.

Way to unlock Gallery Images updated: One of the improvements we had previously planned to make was to distribute the Gallery Images that refer to Escort Forum (chapters related to Thomas' story) as Secret Cards throughout these same chapters, as we consider this Secret Card mechanic to be the one that players like the most.

In previous updates, we opted to, as a preliminary step, unlock all of these Gallery Images at once upon reaching the end of Thomas' story, as we did not have enough time to implement them properly in the game.

We have now implemented them as Secret Cards, according to what our team had planned.

The same was done with the 4 Gallery Images unlocked at the end of the scene The Bunny and the Kitty, which have now also been distributed as Secret Cards throughout the game.

If you want to try to find them, but have already finished the game, we recommend that you delete your save and start a new one.

Jackpot Animation: When you hit a Jackpot in the Slot Machine Minigame, an animation is played along with the previously existing sound effect from now on.

Performance Boost: We have optimized the use of cache memory and RAM, ensuring a significant performance gain. On the other hand, the game's RAM usage has increased and, consequently, the required specifications.

This has resulted in faster loading of game files, which can be especially noticeable in animations, which now run smoothly. You'll also notice that the game will respond more quickly to your inputs from now on.

Some users reported slow loading of animations, so we decided to work on solving the issue.
We hope that with this performance gain, animations will load immediately or, if that is not the case, at least more quickly.

Starting with this update, we recommend at least 3GB of RAM to run the PC version and 2GB of RAM to run the mobile version.

Using devices with lower specifications than this may result in the game not running properly. In practice, this may make it impossible for the game to run on really old mobile devices, but it generated a significant performance gain on the vast majority of other devices.

Committed Reader Achievement: We've reduced the percentage of script that must be read to unlock this achievement from 95% to 90%.
This achievement was harder to unlock than we planned, so we've adjusted the requirements to make it easier for players to reach.

Diagonal Jackpots: From now on, when you manage to line up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" diagonally in the Slot Machine Minigame, it'll count as a Jackpot.

We initially decided to only count a Jackpot when you lined up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" in the center, as we wanted this to be a hard achievement to unlock, but we felt that the difficulty was higher than we had planned.

This change should make it easier to unlock the Jackpot achievement, while still keeping it sufficiently challenging.

Bug Fixes: We found some bugs in the previous version, v0.3.1, and took the chance to fix them before releasing v0.4.0.

The bugs we found were minor and didn't have a major impact on gameplay, with the exception of a bug where character icons would disappear during mobile conversations in specific situations.
In these rare cases, the mobile system layout would become messed up and the message would become impossible to read. This problem is now solved.
We also took the opportunity to fix even minor bugs.

Conclusion
And finally we have reached the end!
We talked a lot in this news, as there was a lot of stuff to tell you, but as we were focused on development, we ended up leaving it a little aside.

We hope you enjoy the new content and the improvements can make your gameplay even better.
Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: Progress Report - 2nd Semester 2024
notes.content:
What's up, guys!
It's been a while since the last news published here regarding the progress in the development of Episode 4.
We're completely focused on the development itself, as we want to deliver the next update to you as soon as possible, and we're very close to that, but while the update does not come, we decided to bring you one more piece of news.

Despite the apparent hiatus, we've been actively developing the project, so we'll take advantage of this news to update you on everything we've progressed so far.
There has been progress in several areas of the game, so to make it easier to understand, we'll separate them by topic.

The first update after the latest news
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/db693041622b3256fc91acac0779ef0ad47b7712.png
It's nothing extraordinary, it's just some renders that are part of a small dialogue that ends the interaction with Sakura, right after her masturbation scene.
In this dialogue, you give her the TV remote, fulfilling her request, as she needs to replace the TV remote in Beatrice's room with the new one you just bought at the shop, as the one in Beatrice's room is defective.
This has a context in the events that happen on the 5th day, you'll understand better when you play.

With these renders and the dialogue that has also been written and inserted into the game, we have definitively completed the interaction with Sakura.

Leon, The Second Customer of the 5th Day
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/f5a81016c7b23ca995c28cda349c27dabc6e1260.png
This topic is about the second customer of day 5: Leon.

As for the preview images attached to this topic, let's go step by step:

In images 6 to 8, we have him drinking the drink that you'll have to serve him in this episode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3227a076d4e32f668599f316c4dd6f857bd28bcd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4920686e42d27ec6c643995b84eb4377939511cd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/893bcb9dbfc7a1fa5089088ffe029a4f412bf359.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/2b6219ee013ba2037053606da905a87457751882.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/bbd21f9dc7207a5ae887dafebbea742e4912ce0a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/caceece33b82f4a2d7b68839bfb1cd24b3963ff7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/689b10bcc53555ae00c426eade38c3bd0b42bd35.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4e99d27e4e5533f94569d807c6f28ddc8ffd01b1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3bbe9209d50bb5752b0b64fb611963dee89775a1.png

Julia Pole Dance Scene - Animation
[previewyoutube=O_zuGhCF_Ug;full][/previewyoutube]
This news highlight surely is the preview video attached to this topic, which shows the final result of this animation.

This is the most complex animation we've worked on so far, with 588 different frames in a single animation. It's a lot of work, but we decided to go all out on this animation because it's the main theme of this episode, so we want it to be really well done.
We had to pose frame by frame, adjusting every detail of the character's body, such as posing each limb, each finger, etc. In addition, we had to make the pose so that there is continuity compared to the previous frames, so that the animation is fluid.
It's quite an achievement, so we hope you enjoy the final result, which you can see in the preview video attached to this topic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/cfb38bd2474e7889a9e6821629c512ba59552848.png
This animation will also have a nude variant that will be part of the same scene. Initially, she was going to dance just wearing the bikini, but we thought players would want to see Julia dancing completely naked, so we decided to include this second version as an extension of the scene.
The nude variant has also had its posing process completed.
This animation is currently in the rendering process.
It'll be posted here at the next opportunity, as it should be finished by then.

We created a script for what will happen during this scene:
[olist]
 She'll walk down the catwalk wearing the bikini.
 She'll do the Pole Dance wearing the bikini.
 There'll be a pause and she'll take off her clothes, throwing it into the audience. (It'll just disappear completely)
 She'll do the Pole Dance again, but this time without clothes.
 She'll walk out to the dressing room, completely nude.
[/olist]
We decided to start with the Pole Dance animation itself, as it's the hardest.
Now that it's done, step 4 of the script will automatically be done as well, since it's the same animation, being just a variation.

Some extra facts about this scene: Unlike the looping animations we usually do, this is an animation that goes from beginning to end once and then ends, which is what makes it so laborious, as it takes more unique frames for the animation to be better utilized.
On the other hand, the final result of the animation is superior, as it presents new movements from beginning to end and, in our opinion, this increases the quality of the animation, as there's always the novelty factor when watching it for the first time.
We also decided to include the backwards version in it, as we realized that this creates an interesting result, so we can increase the duration of the animation and make it loopable, even though we only plan to play it once.

The Julia Pole Dance Scene is not complete yet, as we still have the animations of Julia entering and exiting the catwalk to do, but these animations are extremely easier to do than the pole dance one, so it won't be long until they are done and we can consider this scene finished.
We'll probably bring the conclusion of this scene, along with the missing animations, in the next post.

Conclusion
We know you like to have regular news on the project's development, but there is a reason why we decided to postpone publishing news.
As you can see, most of the progress we've made is related to dialogue between characters or progress in gameplay-related parts.
Although they're also important parts of the game and add to the final product, they don't have the same appeal to the audience as the sex scenes.
For this reason, we decided to wait to accumulate more content and complete at least one erotic scene before posting news here, as we understand that news that only contained dialogue between characters would not be fun.

We apologize for the inconvenience to those eagerly awaiting the next update, and we understand your desire to play and see the content that will arrive in the next version.
We appreciate your interest in following our work and eagerly awaiting each update, because without it, we would have no reason to continue working on the development of this project.
Despite the setbacks, we assure you that we're continuing to actively work on this project and we're really excited to release the next update.

We've never been closer to the release of episode 4, with just one sex scene left to do after we finish the current one, so it's time to get hyped!
We hope you're enjoying what you're seeing in the previews so far.
Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: Progress Report - June/July 2024
notes.content:

notes.title: Progress Report: v0.4 Development
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It has been some time since the release of v0.3.1 and, although there has been enough time for the release of v0.4, it has not yet occurred.
There's a reason for this: There was an unforeseen event during development that caused us to delay our development schedule. However, we make it clear to everyone: Development of this game continues active and a new version will be released as soon as possible.

Let's start by explaining some questions our players may have.

If development continues to be active, why hasn't any news about the game been published here in the meantime?
Until now, we had reserved progress reports showing the work being done only for another platform that we have designed to show this type of content. Initially, we had only reserved patch notes for updates actually released for Steam, but we realized that some players only find out about the progress of development work on Early Access games here, unaware of the existence of other platforms, so we decided to bring these progress reports to Steam as well to keep everyone informed.

We had not noticed this behavior before on the part of players, having even given us some negative feedback, so we apologize for our mistake.

What was the reason for the delay in the v0.4 release?
In the first moments right after the release of v0.3.1, we had planned to do voice acting for all the game's dialogue, using AI.
We liked the result, despite the limitations of the AI, and thought it could be improved, but we planned to finish all the dubbing work before moving on to developing new content.
In this sense, we even dubbed the initial part of the game and released some dubbing videos on our other platform, demonstrating the progress we had made.
Despite this, we received some negative feedback from our supporters, some saying that they preferred us to work on new content, others saying that the result of AI dubbing was not satisfactory, and we decided to open a poll to hear the opinion of all our supporters. Finally, supporters voted to abort the dubbing work and immediately begin development work on v0.4, bringing new content.
As we had to abort the dubbing work and start developing v0.4, this ended up causing a delay in our delivery schedule for the new update.

Here you can see two of the videos we created demonstrating the progress of the voice acting work we were doing, if you're curious.

[previewyoutube=iS2bx2kuANw;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=2Q__00IBr-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Okay, so we know there was a delay, but what stage of development is version 0.4 in?

Well, let's start with the roadmap, showing what we have planned for v0.4.

Roadmap - Plans for v0.4

 Sex scene with Beatrice: Since at the end of v0.3 you had sex with a client, Beatrice thinks it's necessary to teach you how to eat pussy, since you won't always have Luna with you to do this. Therefore, she'll be in charge of teaching you how to do this.
 A small advance in Sakura's story.
 Sakura solo sex scene: If you meet the necessary conditions that the game will show you, you'll unlock a new scene of Sakura masturbating.
This scene will be an extra, something like a secondary quest.
 Development of Julia’s story (Pole Dance Instructor).
 Pole Dance Scene with Julia: As this episode unfolds, Julia will perform a Pole Dance session in the middle of the bar, on the catwalk.
 Sex scene with Julia: At the end of this episode, you'll hear a little more about Julia's story and discover that she decided to become one of the brothel girls too, not just limiting herself to Pole Dancing.
After that, she'll have sex with you as a training session, just like you did with Luna and Veronika.

Well, this is what we have planned for v0.4, just a summary of course.

Perhaps we'll deliver this content divided into two updates (v0.4.0 and v0.4.1), but this will depend on how much time we have left, as we feel it's necessary to deliver updates at a certain frequency to you.

Main Character's New Outfit
As usual, the first step in developing a new update is to define the main character's new outfit and render the images that change according to his outfit.

So we brought some images of the main character in different scenes wearing the new clothes.
